tool_args.rationale: The open-branch data resolve the smooth gradient dependence. The remaining ambiguity is whether the response changes above s_grad ≈ 2.50–2.68. With no dedicated high-gradient probe on the menu, the extra trajectory batch is the remaining relevant option; it can resolve this ambiguity only if it samples above the suspected onset.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the smooth sink-gradient model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It matches the seven rows to rounding precision, but those rows cannot distinguish it from the same model with a supercritical siphon.
Every measured gradient is below the recalled onset range, so neither the threshold nor the siphon strength affects the fitted values.
Its two observations identify the smooth gradient dependence but stop at s_grad = 2.35, below the suspected onset.
